# Payload Progress Percentage at Checkpoints

Source: [1714](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1714); edited 2022-11-12. Evidence: archived documentation, source reported test.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1714-n1"></a>

- Provides archived checkpoint Payload Progress Percentage values for seven Escort and five Hybrid maps.

<a id="wiki-1714-n2"></a>

- Measurements used share code7829N and 50% payload speed; article says payload speed affects the results, so values should not be treated as exact universal constants.
